data.description:
PUNCH FIT is an MR-enabled app that lets you enjoy boxing workouts anywhere, anytime. 
Even beginners can easily have effective workouts, with a variety of options to keep things fresh.
It’s packed with features to help keep you motivated, and it's highly rated by experienced boxers. 
Let's start exercising together!

+++

# FULLY MR-COMPATIBLE
With MR compatibility, you can enjoy workouts easily in any location. 
Of course, it also supports VR.
![{"height":912,"type":"image","width":1712}](https://scontent-fra5-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75230038_4667556543468854_8242817811834050758_n.png?_nc_cat=109&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=TRGhvYjzVpoQ7kNvgFMT80y&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-fra5-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBk7R9sLyEVVE_lXSQ49WAVaQcpE_Cjx3Flz9w2e0oo1g&oe=6720C01D)

+++

# OVER 100 WORKOUTS
We offer a variety of workouts with different difficulty levels and durations. 
You can also filter and save your favorites.
![{"height":913,"type":"image","width":1712}](https://scontent-fra5-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38984459_1576476903229663_8543526547889504215_n.png?_nc_cat=107&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=s7HN6Q5iQjwQ7kNvgHSzq8d&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-fra5-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBzU5pYIJPt_e4F4OwQo70qGfn2TOk2fOHFHWeJXWPMOA&oe=6720D47D)

+++

# MISSIONS TO KEEP YOU GOING
By setting daily and weekly missions as goals, you can continue exercising in a fun and engaging way.
![{"height":911,"type":"image","width":1712}](https://scontent-fra5-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031307_1732633554147432_825388632096175663_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NOwnYtoQqeYQ7kNvgH_Uy_Q&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-fra5-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD7WFxKOoP1qty8zEAM-i6QMHQkcjmiw_hVPoafG5K8QQ&oe=6720C531)

+++

# COMPETE WITH EVERYONE ON THE LEADERBOARD
With the leaderboard, compete with users and friends worldwide, track your progress, and stay motivated on your health journey.
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-fra3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982571_917764220263043_3661853390474153826_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=tP6RDl2U8QYQ7kNvgH_5iOc&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-fra3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBoJ4ynl3w4m61LieatTCE82n0I1XKre9owxg0TTg3PSA&oe=6720D9AC)

+++

# OVER 100 REWARDS
Earn tickets and drops through exercising to unlock packs. You can collect over 100 different skins.
![{"height":913,"type":"image","width":1712}](https://scontent-fra3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974469_549670710853003_3916458436094720897_n.png?_nc_cat=101&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=OxzC3iZVe-4Q7kNvgHLw3dF&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-fra3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCPFMgshQBz1aNyRuPIB8ZY_ovuarBgdNE4yTLjvSg09A&oe=6720AE6A)

+++

Various Updates in Progress.
---
We wish you all the best in your health.

changelog.change_log:
*Adjusted vibration feedback to the controller when punching.
Effects, sounds, vibrations and drop points change with weak and strong punches.

*Calorie consumption display adjustment.
A mistake was made in the calorie notation at the time of results, which has been corrected.
We recommend using Quest's Move app to record calories and exercise.

*Fixed other minor bugs.

*Mixed Reality Capture by "LIV" is now supported.
https://www.liv.tv/
We look forward to seeing videos of you all playing PunchFit.

*Southpaw style play is now supported.
You can select the basic stance from the settings.

*Voice guidance has been adjusted.
Clarified straight and jab after dodge.

Enjoy,
